implementation.enabledOnlyWhen: The controlled actor and NPC target have delivered acceptance, no in-transit message, pending terms, start blockage, interruption, or known retry. Journeys and route versions must remain valid.
implementation.outbound: Use the effective agreed start rather than an earlier arrival only when both travellers can be physically present by that start.
implementation.afterPlayerQuestion: Preserve the actual player question. The NPC answer, agreed end and established return replay at their event days inside the existing remaining interval.

remainingBounds.roundedRouteIssue: An existing derived route can report rounded route.days=2.4 while its physical segment is 2.4337088271510963 days. At rounded day 12.4 the physical journey can still be in transit. This change does not alter the route planner or physical replay; presentByStart preserves the original conservative stops when unfinished segments extend beyond the predicted start. A separate valid late-arrival fixture uses explicit 2.4-day map edges.
remainingBounds.equivalence: Long/split equivalence is established for this committed player/NPC meeting chain and the existing bounded NPC fixtures. It is not a claim that every subsystem or arbitrary world has been proved equivalent.
